title: Recurring restore drill: cadence, reminder and dated evidence
goal: NERV reminds the owner to run the restore drill every agreed interval and records the date of the last one
acceptance: The cadence (proposed: every 90 days) is a setting; the reminder links the drill procedure
The date and result of the last drill are kept and shown next to the backup ages
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one scheduled reminder and one stored date. Not a measurement.
